artifact.name: Z-Girl v3.18 — Human-Centered Demo, Access Protection & Commercial Channel Foundation

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: Candidate completes human-centered integration across consumer and institutional offers, converts public access to premium demo posture, protects live-data/operator surfaces, and adds governed partner-channel positioning. Public release remains locked pending owner approval.

ai_uses.purpose: Adapt private reflection language and prepare participant-controlled transitions to trusted human support
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: AI helps a participant understand a moment, choose a Hero Move, and prepare a clearer real-world conversation without replacing the human relationship
ai_uses.human_oversight: Participants choose whether and what to share; trusted humans retain their real-world roles; affiliates/resellers/sponsors receive no participant reflection authority; public release remains owner-governed
ai_uses.provenance: Z-Girl governed application repository lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach; central 4L Premium + AI Impact gate

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Routine build, demo gating, and governance checks are automated. Participant consent, professional judgment, partner commercial authority, fundraising entity authority, and public release remain human-controlled.

evidence: Human-centered visual context now extends through home, support, athlete, faith, team-pilot, congregation, and partner journeys
Public demo boundary is positioned as a commercial experience rather than an error state
AI adaptation remains focused on reflection and conversation preparation rather than replacement of trusted people
Core journey explicitly connects reflection to achievable action and optional trusted-human support
Sponsored-access and partner pathways are designed to expand access without granting participant-data privileges
Reusable human-centered components reduce duplicated visual logic
Demo middleware blocks live handoff, credential/institution operator, admin, reviewer, and related API surfaces for unauthorized public visitors
Responsive text-first structure, descriptive image alternatives, and existing accessibility system preserved
Existing Z-Girl character asset and Hero Within terminology preserved; no character canon change introduced
Real supporter handoffs and participant-return records are disabled in public demo mode
Institutional and credential operator surfaces are protected
Affiliate/reseller/sponsor pathways explicitly exclude private participant-data access

exceptions: External contextual photography remains candidate presentation media and must be replaced with Greene-controlled masters or independently confirmed for commercial usage before public commercial release.
No commission schedule, reseller margin, affiliate payout, charitable solicitation, tax-deductibility claim, public sponsorship claim, or paid checkout is activated by this candidate.
This receipt authorizes candidate QA only. It does not authorize public release, institutional activation, voice-model promotion, or professional substitution.
